questions.text: What is Artificial Intelligence AI?
options: Technology that enables machines to perform tasks requiring human-like intelligence
questions.explanation: AI enables machines to simulate human-like intelligence.

questions.text: Who is widely known as the father of Artificial Intelligence?
questions.explanation: John McCarthy coined the term AI and organized the 1956 Dartmouth Conference.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of a generative AI chatbot?
questions.explanation: ChatGPT by OpenAI is a generative AI chatbot using large language models.

questions.text: What does ML stand for in the context of AI?
questions.explanation: ML stands for Machine Learning, a subset of AI where systems learn from data.

questions.text: Which of the following is a subfield of Artificial Intelligence?
questions.explanation: NLP is a subfield of AI focused on enabling machines to understand human language.

questions.text: What is the primary purpose of a neural network in AI?
options: To mimic the human brain for pattern recognition and learning
To connect computers to the internet
questions.explanation: Neural networks are systems inspired by the human brain to recognize patterns.

questions.text: Which AI concept involves teaching machines using labeled data?
questions.explanation: Supervised Learning trains a model on labeled data to predict outputs for new inputs.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of AI in everyday life?
options: Voice assistants like Siri or Alexa
questions.explanation: Voice assistants like Siri and Alexa use AI to understand and respond to user commands.

questions.text: What is deep learning in AI?
options: Learning that requires very little data
A type of machine learning using multi-layered neural networks
questions.explanation: Deep Learning uses neural networks with many layers to learn from large amounts of data.

questions.text: Which company developed the AI model GPT-4?
questions.explanation: GPT-4 was developed by OpenAI. Microsoft has integrated it into its products.

questions.text: What does NLP stand for in AI?
questions.explanation: NLP (Natural Language Processing) helps computers understand and generate human language.

questions.text: Which of the following is NOT a type of machine learning?
questions.explanation: The three main ML types are Supervised, Unsupervised, and Reinforcement. Structured Learning is not standard.

questions.text: What is a chatbot?
options: Software that simulates conversation with users
questions.explanation: A chatbot is a computer program designed to simulate human conversation.

questions.text: Which AI tool can generate images from text descriptions?
questions.explanation: DALL-E by OpenAI creates images from text descriptions using generative AI techniques.

questions.text: What is the Turing Test used for?
options: Evaluating whether a machine can exhibit human-like intelligence
questions.explanation: The Turing Test evaluates whether a machine can exhibit intelligent behavior indistinguishable from a human.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes Big Data?
options: Extremely large datasets that cannot be processed by traditional software
A type of database management system
questions.explanation: Big Data refers to datasets so large that traditional software cannot manage them.

questions.text: What does algorithm mean in the context of AI?
options: A step-by-step set of instructions to solve a problem
questions.explanation: An algorithm is a set of step-by-step rules that a computer follows to solve a problem.

questions.text: Which AI application is used in healthcare to analyze medical images?
questions.explanation: Computer Vision enables AI systems to analyze medical images like X-rays and MRIs.

questions.text: What is reinforcement learning?
options: Learning by trial and error with rewards and penalties
questions.explanation: Reinforcement Learning is where an agent learns through rewards and penalties from the environment.

questions.text: Which of the following is a popular programming language used in AI development?
questions.explanation: Python is the most popular AI programming language due to TensorFlow, PyTorch, and scikit-learn.

questions.text: What is computer vision in AI?
options: The ability of computers to process text documents
The ability of AI systems to interpret and understand visual data
questions.explanation: Computer Vision trains computers to interpret the visual world from images and videos.

questions.text: Which technology powers self-driving cars?
questions.explanation: Self-driving cars use AI, ML, computer vision, and sensor fusion to navigate.

questions.text: What is a recommendation system as used by Netflix or Amazon?
options: A system that recommends career choices
An AI system that suggests products or content based on user preferences
questions.explanation: Recommendation systems use ML to suggest relevant content or products based on user behavior.

questions.text: Which of the following is a risk or concern related to AI?
questions.explanation: Key AI concerns include algorithmic bias, privacy violations, and job displacement.

questions.text: What is data training in machine learning?
options: Teaching humans to use data tools
The process of feeding data into an AI model to help it learn patterns
questions.explanation: Data training exposes an AI model to data to learn patterns and improve accuracy.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes a Large Language Model LLM?
options: An AI model trained on huge amounts of text data to understand and generate language
A software for translating programming languages
questions.explanation: An LLM is trained on vast text to understand and generate natural language. Examples: GPT-4 and Gemini.

questions.text: What does IoT stand for?
questions.explanation: IoT (Internet of Things) refers to networked physical devices with sensors exchanging data over the internet.

questions.text: Which Indian city is known as the Silicon Valley of India and a major AI hub?
questions.explanation: Bengaluru is India Silicon Valley due to its concentration of tech companies and AI research centers.

questions.text: What is automation in the context of AI?
options: Using AI to perform repetitive tasks without human intervention
questions.explanation: AI automation uses intelligent systems to perform repetitive tasks automatically.

questions.text: Which of the following is a famous AI personal assistant developed by Apple?
questions.explanation: Siri is Apple AI-powered personal assistant, introduced in 2011.

questions.text: What is facial recognition technology?
options: A camera filter for social media
An AI system that identifies individuals by analyzing facial features
A biometric password tool for keyboards
questions.explanation: Facial recognition uses AI to identify a person from their facial features.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of unsupervised learning?
options: Email spam classification with labeled data
Customer segmentation by grouping similar buying behaviors
Predicting house prices from historical data
questions.explanation: Unsupervised learning finds patterns in unlabeled data. Customer segmentation by clustering is a classic example.

questions.text: What is the role of training data in AI?
options: Data used to test an AI model after deployment
Data used to teach an AI model to recognize patterns and make decisions
Data stored only in cloud servers
Raw data that is never processed
questions.explanation: Training data is used during the AI learning phase to help the model learn patterns.

questions.text: What does API stand for in software and AI context?
questions.explanation: API (Application Programming Interface) allows different software applications to communicate.

questions.text: Which of the following describes prompt engineering in AI?
options: Designing effective input instructions to get desired outputs from AI models
questions.explanation: Prompt engineering designs inputs to guide AI language models toward accurate and relevant responses.

questions.text: What is Google AI model called that was launched as a competitor to ChatGPT?
questions.explanation: Google multimodal AI model is called Gemini (formerly Bard), competing with OpenAI ChatGPT.

questions.text: What is bias in AI models?
options: Systematic errors in AI outputs caused by flawed or unrepresentative training data
A type of AI hardware defect
Extra processing power used by AI
questions.explanation: AI bias produces unfair or inaccurate outputs due to biased training data or model design.

questions.text: What does cloud computing mean in relation to AI?
options: Storing and processing data on remote servers via the internet for AI applications
questions.explanation: Cloud computing provides on-demand resources over the internet enabling AI to scale.

questions.text: Which of the following tasks can AI currently perform?
options: Translating languages diagnosing diseases and generating art
questions.explanation: Current AI translates languages, diagnoses diseases from images, and generates art but cannot feel emotions.

questions.text: What is Generative AI?
options: AI that can create new content such as text images audio and video
questions.explanation: Generative AI creates new content including text, images, music, and video.

questions.text: Which of the following is an AI tool used for writing assistance?
questions.explanation: Grammarly uses AI and NLP to check grammar and improve writing style in real-time.

questions.text: What is overfitting in machine learning?
options: When a model performs well on training data but poorly on new data
When a model is trained with too little data
When an AI model uses too much electricity
When a model has too few parameters
questions.explanation: Overfitting occurs when a model learns training data too well but fails to generalize to new data.

questions.text: What does GPU stand for and why is it important for AI?
options: General Processing Unit used for office tasks
Graphics Processing Unit whose parallel processing accelerates AI and ML training
Global Processing Utility used for internet access
Graphical Programming Unit used for coding AI
questions.explanation: GPU accelerates AI training through parallel processing of many calculations simultaneously.

questions.text: Which AI-powered tool helps doctors detect diseases from X-ray or MRI images?
questions.explanation: AI diagnostic imaging tools like DeepMind analyze medical scans to detect diseases accurately.

questions.text: What is the primary function of a search engine that uses AI?
options: To find and rank relevant web pages based on user queries using AI algorithms
questions.explanation: AI-powered search engines use ML to understand queries and rank the most relevant results.

questions.text: Which of the following is a major ethical concern about AI-generated content deepfakes?
options: It can spread misinformation and be used for fraud or defamation
It is too expensive to create
questions.explanation: Deepfakes pose ethical concerns including spreading misinformation, fraud, and reputational damage.

questions.text: What is robotics in the context of AI?
options: The integration of AI with mechanical systems to create machines that can act in the physical world
questions.explanation: AI robotics combines AI with mechanical engineering to create intelligent physical machines.

questions.text: Which of these is a common use of AI in the banking and finance sector?
questions.explanation: AI in finance is used for real-time fraud detection, automated credit scoring, and algorithmic trading.

questions.text: What is speech recognition in AI?
options: A technology that converts text to images
The ability of AI to identify and convert spoken language into text
A machine that creates speeches for politicians
questions.explanation: Speech recognition uses AI to convert spoken words into text, enabling voice-controlled applications.

questions.text: Which of the following is an example of AI being used in education?
options: Adaptive learning platforms that personalize content for each student
questions.explanation: AI adaptive learning platforms like Khan Academy tailor content to individual student needs.

questions.text: What is predictive analytics in AI?
options: Using historical data and AI to forecast future outcomes or trends
questions.explanation: Predictive analytics uses ML and statistics to forecast future outcomes from historical data.

questions.text: Which AI technology is used in virtual assistants to understand user intent?
questions.explanation: Natural Language Understanding (NLU) enables AI to comprehend the meaning and intent behind human language.

questions.text: What does open source AI mean?
options: AI that is only open to government agencies
AI whose source code is publicly available for anyone to use modify and distribute
AI that operates without an internet connection
AI developed by one company exclusively
questions.explanation: Open source AI projects like LLaMA and Stable Diffusion have publicly accessible code for anyone to use.

questions.text: Which of the following describes AI hallucination?
options: When an AI model confidently generates false or fabricated information
When AI overheats due to excess processing
When AI systems see infrared light
questions.explanation: AI hallucination is when a model generates plausible-sounding but incorrect information with high confidence.

questions.text: Which industry is NOT typically associated with AI applications?
questions.explanation: While AI revolutionizes healthcare, agriculture, and finance, traditional manual crafts like pottery are not AI-associated.

questions.text: What is transfer learning in AI?
options: Applying knowledge gained from one task to improve performance on a related task
Transferring AI models to cloud servers
questions.explanation: Transfer learning applies a pre-trained model to a different but related task, saving time and compute.

questions.text: What is the significance of the year 1950 in AI history?
options: Alan Turing published Computing Machinery and Intelligence and proposed the Turing Test
The first AI robot was built
questions.explanation: In 1950, Alan Turing published his landmark paper proposing the Turing Test asking Can Machines Think.

questions.text: What does AGI stand for in AI research?
questions.explanation: AGI (Artificial General Intelligence) is hypothetical AI that can perform any intellectual task a human can do.

questions.text: Which of the following is the best definition of data privacy in AI?
options: Keeping AI code secret from competitors
Protecting individuals personal information from unauthorized access or misuse by AI systems
Storing data only on personal computers
questions.explanation: Data privacy in AI ensures personal data is collected, stored, and used responsibly with user consent.

questions.text: Which of the following best describes AI ethics?
options: Rules for AI robots to follow in factories
A set of moral principles and guidelines for the responsible development and use of AI
Technical standards for AI hardware manufacturing
A course taught only in computer science departments
questions.explanation: AI ethics examines moral implications of AI including fairness, transparency, accountability, and societal impact.
